reviews_h2: Straight from the people who called us

reviews.author: Joe Piddington
reviews.text: I had a very disappointing experience with Mike Price and would not recommend him for any landscaping work. The project was to grade my lawn, but the work created significant issues with my property. We were unable to park in our driveway for several days because of the condition it was left in, even though the driveway was not part of the scope of work. The job was never completed, and the work that was done left my property in worse condition than before. Landscape fabric that had been installed beneath the stone to prevent weeds was torn up, leaving a mess throughout my yard and driveway. I have since spent more than 15 hours of my own time trying to clean up and correct the issues, and I now have grass growing through areas of the driveway where there were no problems before. To make matters worse, a tractor was left on my property for more than two weeks. When it was finally removed, it was picked up while I was at work, and no one returned to complete the project. Because the work was left unfinished, I have had to hire other contractors to complete and repair the job. Despite this, Mike is seeking payment for the remaining balance. The matter is currently being resolved through the court system, and I will provide an update once the case has been decided. I renovated my entire house without any significant issues with other contractors, which makes this experience even more frustrating. Based on my experience, I would strongly encourage others to do their due diligence before hiring. He's rude and certainly cannot run a skid steer! Just look at these pictures and video of me fixing what he should have done! You honestly can't make this up!

reviews.author: Debra Dasaro
reviews.text: Mike has taken care of my lawn for almost 10 years, and I have been exceptionally happy with everything he has done. His lawn care is always reliable and immaculate, and beyond that, he has also designed beautiful gardens and landscaping for me. Mike is professional, dependable, and genuinely cares about the people he works for. It’s rare to find someone who takes such pride in every detail, he truly is the best!

reviews.author: Bari Bradley
reviews.text: Mike Price Lawn Service has been taking care of our property and we couldn’t be happier with their work. They are always dependable, show up when they say they will, and consistently do a beautiful job. On top of that, their pricing is very reasonable, which is hard to find these days. It’s clear they take pride in what they do and genuinely care about their customers. I highly recommend Mike Price Lawn Service to anyone looking for reliable, high-quality landscaping services as well as snow plowing.
